text:
Marta: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem — want to finalize owners, RACI, and due dates for the cache churn remediation. Keeping this thread for assignments only.

Marta: Recap (very short): recurring cache evictions under mixed-length traffic; impact: increased tail latency and instance thrash. Postmortem listed 5 follow-ups. Please pick or propose owners + Jira IDs.

Marta: Actions list (copied):
```
- P1: Build a deterministic repro that exercises mixed-sequence pressure.
- P2: Tune eviction scoring + add adaptive cooldown.
- P3: Add high-cardinality eviction metrics + SLA alert.
- P4: Update failover runbook + map RACI for model fallback.
- P5: Establish owner rotation + handoff checklist, include oncall ops play.
```

Owen: I'll take P1 (repro). Will spin up a small harness and a k8s job to run nightly. ETA: 10 business days.

jira-bot: Created RW-5620: "repro-harness: cache-churn-mixed-seq" assigned to Owen. https://jira.redwood/RW-5620

Priya: I'll own P3 (metrics/alerts). Plan: add histogram of eviction-duration by shard, and a top-n eviction-source gauge. Can deliver draft alert rules in 5 days.

Sean: For P2 (eviction tuning) I can be accountable (A). Need an implementation owner—Owen, would you pair for test integration? I can do design in 1 week, then implementation 2-3 weeks.

Owen: happy to collaborate on P2 as implementation owner (R). I'll update RW-5620 with a subtask for integration.

Marta: Good — let's capture RACI here:
- P1: Owen (R), Priya (C)
- P2: Sean (A), Owen (R), Priya (C)
- P3: Priya (A)
- P4: Marta (A), Sean (C)
- P5: Marta (A), ops (C)

Priya: Created RW-5625 for P3 alerts, due 1773700000. Will attach sample queries and dashboard link.

jira-bot: Created RW-5625: "eviction-metrics-alerts" assigned to Priya. https://jira.redwood/RW-5625

ops-bot: Reminder: all incident follow-ups must link to postmortem doc for compliance. Use label PM-FOLLOWUP.

Marta: Please add due dates to all tickets and link back to the postmortem doc. Also add a short acceptance criteria on each ticket (what 'done' looks like).

Sean: Will add design doc and acceptance criteria to RW-5630 (creating now) and set due 1774100000.

jira-bot: Created RW-5630: "eviction-adaptive-cooldown-design" assigned to Sean. https://jira.redwood/RW-5630

Owen: For P5 (rotation + checklist) I propose a 90-day owner rotation schedule and a 10-item handoff checklist in the runbook. I'll draft the checklist and schedule in the runbook repo. ETA: 7 days.

Marta: Can we also add a short 15-min weekly sync for the first 3 weeks post-change? Capture meeting notes in the ticket.

Priya: Yes, I'll host the first sync and add calendar invites titled "pm-followup: cache churn" recurring weekly x3.

Sean: Ack. I'll post progress updates to the RW-5630 ticket and ping this thread weekly.

Marta: Thanks team — I updated the postmortem with the RW IDs and the RACI table. If ownership changes, update the Jira ticket and post here. Closing assignment phase for now.

Owen: Ack. Starting work on RW-5620.
